promptLatex: How many integers from 1 to 50 are divisible by 4 or 5?
hintLatex: Count multiples of 4, count multiples of 5, then subtract multiples of 20 (LCM of 4 and 5).
There are 12 multiples of 4, 10 multiples of 5, and 2 multiples of 20.
solutionLatex:
Use the inclusion-exclusion principle.

Multiples of 4 from 1 to 50: \lfloor 50/4 \rfloor = 12.
Multiples of 5 from 1 to 50: \lfloor 50/5 \rfloor = 10.
Multiples of both 4 and 5 (i.e., multiples of 20) from 1 to 50: \lfloor 50/20 \rfloor = 2.

By inclusion-exclusion: 12 + 10 - 2 = 20.
